purpose: Define one execution-aware cash-and-position ledger for every future three-session factor diagnostic without selectively rerunning the rejected 43-factor historical frontier.

effective_scope.applies_to: Every factor diagnostic newly executed after this policy is implemented, including future daily, event, minute, and classified-moneyflow mechanisms.

eligible_before_ranking: signal-session OHLC are finite and positive
signal-session volume is finite and positive
signal_policy.ranking: Descending directional factor score, then instrument ascending.

entry_policy.orders: Submit only the close-known Top3 names; do not inspect or substitute lower-ranked names after an entry outcome.
entry_policy.nominal_slot_budget: Free cash at the entry open divided equally across all three registered slots.
fill_requires: entry-session OHLC are finite and positive
entry-session volume is finite and positive
entry bar is not one-price upper-limit-like
entry_policy.blocked_slot: Keep that slot's budget in cash for the cohort; do not reallocate it to another selected or unselected name.

exit_policy.planned_session: third local trading-session close after the signal close
planned_or_delayed_fill_requires: exit-session OHLC are finite and positive
exit-session volume is finite and positive
exit bar is not one-price lower-limit-like
exit_policy.blocked_exit: Retain the position and attempt the same full-position sale at each later local close.
exit_policy.maximum_delay: Twenty local sessions after the planned exit; an unfilled position after the cap makes the execution gate fail.
exit_policy.exit_price: first eligible planned-or-delayed session adjusted close
exit_policy.capital_reuse: Exit proceeds become available only after that close and may fund an entry from the next local session onward.

one_price_limit_like_policy.entry_upper_reference: entry one-price OHLC divided by signal close minus one
one_price_limit_like_policy.exit_lower_reference: exit one-price OHLC divided by previous local-session close minus one
one_price_limit_like_policy.interpretation: A limit-like bar does not prove no market trades. The ledger conservatively assumes no fill because queue priority is unavailable.

event_order_within_session: process any registered entry at the session open using cash available before the open
mark all open positions at the session close
process planned or delayed exits at the session close
ledger_policy.multiple_cohorts: Delayed positions keep their capital locked; later scheduled cohorts may invest only cash still available before their entry open.
ledger_policy.same_instrument_multiple_lots: Keep each cohort lot separate because planned exit dates can differ.
ledger_policy.equity_curve: Daily close cash plus marked value of every open lot; carry the most recent positive close through a suspended session only for marking, never for a claimed fill.
ledger_policy.signal_cutoff: Form no signal whose planned exit plus the maximum delay would exceed the diagnostic data window.
ledger_policy.entry_failure_return_imputation: No return is imputed; the unfilled slot remains cash.
ledger_policy.exit_failure_return_imputation: No sale or realized return is imputed; the lot stays open until a valid exit or terminal failure.

research_boundaries.level2_reconsideration: Only after a lower-cost factor passes association and this execution gate and the remaining uncertainty is specifically attributable to queue or fill priority.
